title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in properfraction…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in ProfilePress wp-user-avatar plugin versions up to 4.17.7 due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This vulnerability allows code injection via crafted input. The issue is classified as CWE-80 and has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 4.3, indicating medium severity.
